note: NBA V5: independent empirical player-game joint worlds produce the final statistical projection, with the original 10000-world possession reference run separately, no averaging or V4/V3 forecast borrowing. V3 supplies roster/participation inputs until source decoupling; official injury and lineup evidence can update availability. No sportsbook input.
empirical_game_model_research_limit: Historical paired tests used retrospectively known rosters; live first-seen outcomes must be graded for genuine forward certification.
